gate_probe.method: incumbent (route off) fixes the trajectory eagerly; candidate teacher-forced on the same tokens; per-position logit KL via evaluate_logits; 512-token random-token contexts, 64 positions each
gate_probe.verdict: NOT ROUTED. 6/8 contexts pass the section-6.1 mean (1e-3) but seed 59 breaches both the mean (2.19e-3) and the absolute max-row ceiling (5.85e-2 > 5e-2). Top-1 agreement 100% everywhere; prefill-position sanity KL exactly 0. The error is pure summation-order noise (per-element products identical to the strict owner), so unlike the integer-MMQ route there is no arithmetic defect, but a route that cannot provably pass stays unrouted. Enabling is a one-line policy edit pending the full 162-row production-referenced gate or an envelope decision.

w4a16_crossover_task6_data.finding: W4A16 beats the strict GEMV only from 12 rows (large shapes; 24 for the narrowest) and is 4x SLOWER at rows=1, so decode cannot route through W4A16 and the shared min_rows=8 is wrong for W4A16 on gfx1100 (0.68x at 8 rows)

limitations: The gate probe uses random-token 512-token contexts, not the campaign 18-prompt category fixture (not present in this tree); the full production-referenced gate remains owed.
